D/ [--]STANS PF AVG ; R/ [GLORI] A EXER CITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17, in very fine condition. Obverse description: Bust rosette diademed cuirassed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]STANS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; a square vexillum bears a Y-shaped figure. Mintmark indistinct.
